subject: Re-indent code and reduce code being complied on Solaris for anetKeepAlive (#12914)
reason: The change is a re-indentation and comment reformat of src/anet.c plus a restructuring of the Solaris-only (#ifdef __sun) section of anetKeepAlive from an '#if ... return' followed by always-compiled fallback code into an #if/#else/#endif. The previously always-compiled fallback was unreachable at runtime when TCP_KEEPIDLE/TCP_KEEPINTVL/TCP_KEEPCNT were defined, so excluding it from compilation changes nothing observable; the socket options set and the control flow are identical on every platform.
